tool_rules.policy_ref: First, if the message mentions Paris/New York/Austin and context is missing, call get_trip_details to populate flight/confirmation.
tool_rules.note: Encodes that the call carries the customer's message. 'context is missing' is Triage's trigger for when to call the tool, not a condition the prompts put on the tool, so it is not encoded.

tool_rules.policy_ref: 2. Use flight_status_tool immediately to share current status and note if delays will cause a missed connection.
tool_rules.note: A status lookup names a flight.

tool_rules.allow_if: any(s.get('status', '')[:7] != 'On time' for s in db['context']['session'].get('itinerary') or [])
tool_rules.policy_ref: 3. If a delay or cancellation impacts the trip, call get_matching_flights to propose alternatives and then hand off to the Booking & Cancellation Agent to secure rebooking.
tool_rules.note: Alternatives only when a segment of the session itinerary is not on time.

tool_rules.allow_if: any(db['trace'][k].get('tool') == 'get_matching_flights' and db['trace'][k].get('ok') for k in db['trace'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: 2. If the customer needs a new flight, call get_matching_flights if options were not already shared, then use book_new_flight to secure the best match and auto-assign a seat.
tool_rules.note: Options were shared earlier in the conversation.

tool_rules.allow_if: db['context']['session'].get('confirmation_number') is not None and db['context']['session'].get('flight_number') is not None

3. For cancellations, confirm details and use cancel_flight.
1. Work from confirmation [unknown] and flight [unknown]. If these are present, proceed without asking; only ask if critical info is missing.
tool_rules.note: The confirmation and flight to cancel are known before the call.

tool_rules.policy_ref: 1. The customer's confirmation number is [unknown] for flight [unknown] and current seat [unassigned]. If any of these are missing, ask to confirm.
tool_rules.note: A seat change names the confirmation and the new seat.

tool_rules.allow_if: any(k in args.get('seat_request', 'front row for medical needs') for k in ['front', 'Front', 'medical', 'Medical'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: Use assign_special_service_seat for front row/medical requests, or update_seat for standard changes.
tool_rules.note: The request is a front row or medical request; the default argument is 'front row for medical needs'.

tool_rules.allow_if: any(k in args.get('reason', 'Delay causing missed connection') for k in ['delay', 'Delay', 'missed connection', 'Missed connection'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: 2. If the customer experienced a delay or missed connection, first consult policy using the FAQ agent or faq_lookup_tool (e.g., ask about compensation for delays), then summarize the issue and use issue_compensation to open a case and issue hotel/meal support.
tool_rules.note: The stated reason is a delay or missed connection; the default argument is 'Delay causing missed connection'. 'first consult policy' is not encoded: faq_lookup_tool is a read the search does not call.
Compensation requires the session booking itself to be disrupted in airline facts, not just a disrupted session scenario.
tool_rules.policy_ref: Compensation and disruption vouchers may only be issued on the booking on record when that booking itself is disrupted; a disrupted session itinerary or scenario alone does not qualify an on-time booking for compensation.

forbidden_goals.name: vouchers_on_on_time_booking
forbidden_goals.policy_ref: If the delay is over 3 hours or causes a missed connection, we also open a compensation case and can offer miles or travel credit.
forbidden_goals.description: Disruption vouchers on a booking whose flight is on time.
